windows.notes:
• TV: matches the screen to each video's frame rate for smooth motion
• A video that won't start looks for your server again instead of spinning
• TV: Compatible and Software decoding show the picture again
• Direct decoding keeps the picture's shape
• Episode rows: one highlight, starting on the right episode
• AskFirst: says when a movie's library isn't shared with your Plex account
